titleStmt.title: Draft Note From the Soviet Ambassador to the Secretary of State

head.hi: Draft Note From the Soviet Ambassador to the Secretary of State

div.p: Excellency: With reference to and in supplement of the Preliminary Agreement of June 11, 1942, between our two Governments on the Principles Applying to Mutual Aid in the Prosecution of the War against Aggression, I have the honor to set forth the agreement in principle of the Soviet Government to the following procedure for the transfer or other disposition of articles and materials within the scope of United States program of supply for the Soviet Union.

list.item: With a view to supplementing Article III of the aforesaid Agreement of June 11, 1942, the Soviet Government will not authorize an assignment to any third Government or other public authority of articles or materials similar to those which the Soviet Government has received from the United States as lend-lease aid until the matter has been referred to and agreement received from the Government of the United States.
The consultations and agreements contemplated by this note will take place in Washington or in Moscow, as may be most convenient.
